errors.evidence: The description does not mention the legend, which is located in the top right corner and identifies the two lines.
The description fails to mention the markers used for the data points on each line: circular markers for the "w.o. extension" line and triangular markers for the "extension" line.
The final data point for the blue "w.o. extension" line at x=4 has a y-value of approximately 0.916, which is clearly below the 0.920 grid line. The description incorrectly states the value is 0.921.
Both lines start at the same y-value of approximately 0.968. The description gives a different starting value for the orange "extension" line, which is inaccurate.
The final data point for the orange "extension" line at x=4 has a y-value of approximately 0.918, which is below the 0.920 grid line. The description incorrectly states the value is exactly 0.920.
